improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals and traders. The copy highlights core value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) and the low-friction entry point (three free searches) without inventing claims.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for business owners and trade professionals. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its purpose, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the low-friction entry point of three free searches with no payment barrier. This reduces hesitation and drives trial engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for trial users approaching the paywall. It transparently explains the next step, reinforces value (unlimited workspace, voice chat, professional support), and highlights both entry pricing and the annual savings incentive—reducing hesitation and encouraging conversion.
